body: Persistent textual memory lets language-model agents reuse lessons from past tasks to improve on future multi-step tasks without retraining. Systems such as ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet keep it as a playbook: lessons the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt. A key challenge is to decide which lessons improve later tasks. Current systems leave the decision to the agent itself, which makes performance unstable: the same procedure can write a playbook that helps or one that falls up to 69.6 points below no playbook. These findings motivate valuing lessons by their measured effect on task success rather than by the agent's judgment. We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks. It groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably and, on each practice task, includes or leaves out every block at random. Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help and, since the same procedure can write a helpful or a harmful playbook, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. Across two memory systems, three models and three benchmarks, RBC raises average success to 66.9, against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and 53.8 when the agent's own judgment picks the lessons to keep.
summaryZh: 针对智能体在多步任务中自我编写和维护记忆（Playbook）表现不稳定的问题，本文提出了随机块策划（RBC）方法。研究指出，依赖智能体自身判断记忆价值会导致性能波动，因此引入随机实验来量化记忆块对任务成功率的实际影响。通过在实践任务中随机包含或排除记忆块，RBC能够筛选出真正有效的记忆，显著提升了智能体在多项基准测试中的平均成功率，为智能体长期记忆管理提供了科学的评估框架。

glossary.explanationZh: 持久化文本记忆，指智能体在任务间保留和复用经验的机制。
随机块策划，一种通过随机实验评估记忆块对任务表现影响的筛选方法。
智能体手册，记录智能体在任务后总结的经验，用于后续任务提示。
任务成功率，衡量智能体在特定任务中达成目标的比例。
